location: p. 4778, right column, paragraph 'Fitting these intrinsic KIEs to the Arrhenius equation ...'

Intrinsic values were calculated from the observed H/T and D/T V/K KIEs with the Northrop equation (T(V/K)H,obs^-1 - 1)/(T(V/K)D,obs^-1 - 1) = ((kH/kT)^-1 - 1)/((kH/kT)^(-1/3.34) - 1); quantity kept kcat/KM as the schema prescribes.
